_meta.title: Ferrioxalate actinometer, 313 nm, 6 mM, 1 cm cuvette (Hatchard-Parker type)
_meta.source: Only these keys are literature-backed: Phi = 1.24 at 313 nm, 6 mM K3[Fe(C2O4)3], 1 cm quartz cuvette, 3.00 mL (so 3 cm2 window), >99% absorbed below 390 nm: Beilstein J. Org. Chem. 2013, 9, 217, Supporting Information (opened and read; it cites Hatchard & Parker, Proc. R. Soc. A 235, 518 (1956), doi 10.1098/rspa.1956.0102, not opened). Phi range 1.25-0.9 over 250-500 nm and 0.006-0.20 M solutions: IUPAC Tech. Report, doi 10.1351/pac200476122105 (opened via PDF copy). Lamp power, distance, wall and molar absorptivity are NOT from the paper and stay at ParamDef defaults (flagged in the UI).
